decisions.reason: The formwork profile line sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep, and with no evidence of failure the option remains worth holding as the firm expands.

The automated distributor flow control is embedded in the firm's automation strategy and its upside from rising demand for automation is still unfolding, so keeping it at low holding cost is justified.
The magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line with their own page, a core consumable for precast plants, cheap to maintain and likely generating steady demand.
This component is close to the established magnetic formwork offer, so its holding cost is minimal and no result so far shows its value will not be realized.

The component overlaps with other magnetic products and is only mentioned on the website, which makes consolidation possible, but the cost of keeping it is low and the evidence still does not justify dropping it.
